q2_gaps: "many" used as a COUNT of things rather than a proportion: the instruction set assigns "many" to the strength dial (0.7) with a `QuantifierPhrase` companion, and omits it from the `CardinalityPhrase` vague-quantity list ("a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of"), so a counting "many Ns" has no stated channel.

Season names as time fillers, and durative span frames over them ("through summer", "by autumn"): seasons appear only as deictic constants (last_spring / next_summer), so a bare `summer` / `autumn` has no structured term, and the "through" extent has no carrier.
notes: The whenever rule, per-occurrence Skolem group `(sk_feathers $h)`, the `During` tie, "by autumn" as `TimeAtMost`, top-level definite base/cliff with `PartOf`, `sky_cat` genus with the noun modifier unexposed, and `Location` on the event only (no `LocatedIn` on the feathers) all follow the instruction set. `CardinalityPhrase "many"` is defensible under "use CardinalityPhrase only when the phrase counts things" but sits on the gap above.
